claimed_invariant: A note attached to a class relationship is styled in the owning link's captured style context. Java SvekEdge passes that StyleBuilder to EntityImageNoteLink, which resolves the inherited root.element.sequenceDiagram.note signature; root properties such as defaultFontName therefore participate unless a note-specific property overrides them. The resolved FontConfiguration is shared by preferred-dimension calculation and painting. Standalone notes retain their entity-style snapshot semantics.
causal_divergence: Rust's parser and style program already retain root defaultFontName and noteFontName, but ResolvedNoteStyle::for_note reads only literal note skinparams and otherwise hardcodes sans-serif. A link note under `skinparam defaultFontName Arial` is consequently measured and painted with sans-serif, so its natural width and font-family diverge together. This is independent of the three-pixel relationship-label Creole baseline fault that appears in the same preserved checker_07 input.
planned_model_change: Give link-owned notes an explicit owning-relationship style context. Resolve Java's link-note signature through StyleCascade::resolve_link_at_source_line at the relationship source line, including inherited root defaults and note-specific overrides, then use one resolved note style for both natural dimensions and SVG painting. Keep standalone-note resolution separate and preserve source-order capture semantics; do not globally replace all note styling.
perturbation_axes: legacy skinparam versus CSS root and note styles
style declaration before versus after relationship creation
width-sensitive short and long note text
plain relationship labels versus mixed Creole labels as a negative control
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns font and inherited style resolution for link-owned notes and the consistency of their measurement and painting. It does not own relationship-label Creole alignment, link-note grammar or position, standalone-note ownership, route synthesis, comparator behavior, baselines, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: Fresh valid inputs show root font inheritance, note override precedence, and source-order link capture matching Java.
Link-note preferred dimensions and emitted text use the same resolved font family and size.
Standalone-note and no-note controls do not regress.
An independent checker audits the Java and Rust style data flow, generates held-outs over at least two axes, and records a verdict at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing Arial, checker_07 text, fixture names, or expected dimensions
changing note box constants, route geometry, comparator tolerance, baselines, skips, or fixture eligibility
